description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractCache for managing cache operations related to entities in the OFBiz framework, including cache naming, clearing, and retrieval methods.

classes.name: AbstractCache
classes.description: An abstract class providing cache management functionalities for entity caching, including cache name generation, cache clearing, and cache retrieval.

methods.name: AbstractCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with delegator name and id, setting cache name prefix.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator instance associated with the delegator name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries for a specific entity name.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all caches that start with the cache name prefix.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefix
methods.description: Returns the cache name prefix string.

methods.name: getCacheNamePrefixes
methods.description: Returns an array of cache name prefix strings.

methods.name: getCacheName
methods.description: Generates the cache name for a specific entity.

methods.name: getCacheNames
methods.description: Returns an array of cache name patterns for a specific entity.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves the cache instance for a specific entity.

methods.name: getOrCreateCache
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a cache instance for a specific entity.
